staff can view organization audit entrie.name: staff can view organization audit entries
staff can view organization audit entrie.using:
exists (
        select 1 from organization_memberships membership
        where membership.organization_id = "audit_entries"."organization_id"
          and membership.user_id = auth.uid()
          and membership.archived_at is null
          and membership.role = 'super_admin'
      )
